title: Intuitive Surgical Q2 2026 earnings release (SEC Exhibit 99.1)
excerpt: Q2 2026 combined procedures grew about 16%, revenue grew 19%, GAAP operating income grew 31%, and cash plus investments totaled USD 8.63 billion.
summary: The unchanged SEC-filed Q2 release continues to support procedure growth, recurring instruments and accessories revenue, operating leverage and balance-sheet strength.
